reviews.t: I am beyond thankful we found BMP Weekday School. My children were given exactly what they needed to thrive in ways they never have before. I feel like we had family watching the kids but even better ... they learned social skills, practical skills, and had the best time playing. The clear and consistent information during COVID was priceless and kept our children as safe as possible. We missed a lot of church opportunities during COVID and I am so thankful for the spiritual lessons that were appropriately woven into the classroom so that my kids know the meaning and source of love and service. Thank you, thank you, thank you all. I couldn't ask for a better partner to help raise my children.
